# CLI reference

Every command of `agent-events`, generated from the CLI itself.

The CLI needs no MCP server and no agent. Install `@agentcomms/events-daemon` and run it.

```bash
npx -y @agentcomms/events-daemon <command>          # without installing
npm i -g @agentcomms/events-daemon && agent-events   # or on the PATH
```

`<angle brackets>` are required, `[square brackets]` optional, `<name...>` repeats. Every command takes
`--json` for a machine-readable envelope, and `--no-color` to drop ANSI codes.

## Exit codes

Scripts should read these rather than parse output.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | it worked |
| `1` | unexpected failure |
| `10` | a local service action needs a person or is unavailable |
| `11` | a newer release is out: update first (`agentcomms update`), or put it off until tomorrow (`agentcomms update --later`) |
| `64` | the command was used wrongly |
| `65` | the data given was not usable |
| `66` | what was asked for does not exist |
| `69` | the local service is unavailable |
| `75` | temporary; retrying later is reasonable |
| `77` | a local permission is needed |
| `78` | a local service configuration problem |

## Commands

| Command | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [`status`](#agent-events-status) | report whether the local event service has an owner |
| [`mcp`](#agent-events-mcp) | serve the MCP interface over standard input and output |

### `agent-events status`

report whether the local event service has an owner

```
agent-events status [options]
```

### `agent-events mcp`

serve the MCP interface over standard input and output

```
agent-events mcp [options]
```
